business_scope.primary_industry_name: Die-Struck Brass Cloisonné Polishing of Novelty Enamel Badges

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (Republic of the Marshall Islands)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (United States-derived statutory corporate law under the Business Corporations Act 1990, English common-law interpretive principles, and customary traditional law overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Amended Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (2003)
Convention between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income
Convention of 5 October 1961 Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents (Hague Apostille Convention)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), 2017

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (B.C.A.), Title 24 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code; Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012, as amended, and subsidiary AML/CFT Regulations; Beneficial Ownership Information (Confidential Register) Regulations; Financial Intelligence Unit Act; Proceeds of Crime Act; and implementing standards endorsed under the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) Mutual Evaluation process.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (confidential beneficial-ownership file maintained by the licensed Registered Agent and the Registrar of Corporations; access restricted to the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit, domestic tax authorities, and law enforcement acting under lawful process; not available to the public or through commercial registry search)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certified Copy of Government-Issued Passport for each Subscriber, Director, and 25% or greater Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the applicant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing state is a party to the 1961 Convention; otherwise Consular Legalization by the Republic of the Marshall Islands diplomatic or consular officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Incorporation including notarized Subscriber/Incorporator signature pages
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporator/Subscriber together with the licensed RMI Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization; Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization only where execution occurs under foreign law and the Registered Agent requests authentication of the foreign signature

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Consent to Act as Director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each proposed Director in his or her country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for foreign-origin instruments; notarization is sufficient for instruments executed in the Republic of the Marshall Islands

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank or Professional Reference Letter and Source of Wealth Certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing regulated bank, licensed attorney-at-law, or certified public accountant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy furnished through the applicant's professional; Apostille/Consular Legalization not customarily required for the Registered Agent's AML file, but any non-English document must be accompanied by a sworn translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every proposed director, shareholder, beneficial owner, authorized signatory, and material commercial counterparty against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, HM Treasury Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestic Marshall Islands financial watchlist. Domestic and foreign Politically Exposed Persons must be identified under FATF Recommendation 12, risk-rated, and approved by the Registered Agent's AML Compliance Officer prior to incorporation; enhanced due diligence requires documented source of wealth and source of funds. Sanctions or adverse negative-media hits result in refusal of the engagement or a statutory report to the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registrar of Corporations, International Registry Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; electronic filing is administered exclusively through licensed RMI Registered Agents via the Marshall Islands Corporate Registry e-Filing System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official corporate-name language is English. Proposed names must use Latin-script characters; non-Latin scripts and logographic characters are not accepted for the primary registered name, although a supplementary transliteration may be noted. Approved corporate identifiers are 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', 'Company' or their abbreviations 'Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Ltd.', 'Co.'. The registered name must be distinguishable from every existing name and must not convey an unlawful, misleading, or governmental purpose.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: International (where the usage falsely implies official or supranational status)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registrar refuses a name, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal within ten business days of the Notice of Refusal, stating grounds that the name is not confusingly similar, is not misleading, and does not prejudice the public interest, and attaching any ministerial consent and the applicable appeal fee. The Registrar must issue a written determination within fifteen business days. A final administrative rejection may be challenged by judicial review in the High Court of the Marshall Islands within thirty days of the determination. A name reservation may be renewed once before expiry by filing the prescribed renewal application and fee; the renewal term does not exceed the original 30-day window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Expressly permissible for this industry (ISIC 3240 low-risk manufacture and e-commerce merchandising of hard enamel lapel pins). The Business Corporation must maintain a registered office at the business address of its licensed Registered Agent in Majuro; no physical office, employees, or local installation in the Marshall Islands is required. The Registered Agent's virtual-office service, comprising statutory address, service-of-process acceptance, mail forwarding, and records custody, satisfies the statutory substance requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified as low: approximately 3% to 5% annual probability for a standardized non-resident Business Corporation in a low-risk banking and AML tier. Unannounced physical on-site inspection is not a routine statutory practice; the Registrar or the Financial Intelligence Unit may activate an inspection only upon adverse intelligence, sanctions or PEP alerts, or irregular filing behavior.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year licensed Registered Agent service fee covering statutory agency, registered office, and corporate records custody
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent (private service provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standardized non-resident, low-risk business corporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Virtual registered office and mail-forwarding service in Majuro (first year)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market compliance fee for confidential beneficial-ownership records

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate dependent on origin and destination jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee for a standard offshore Business Corporation incorporation; not a statutory tariff

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, as amended and codified in Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code; specifically Section 15 (filing of Articles of Incorporation), Section 17 (registered office and registered agent), Section 32 (subscription for shares), and Section 46 (appointment of officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation filed with the Registrar of Corporations under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a non-resident Business Corporation; authorized capital is set forth in the Articles of Incorporation, and no escrow deposit or proof of capitalization is required for incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the corporation accepts subscription for 1,000 ordinary shares at a par value of US$1.00 per share from the incorporator, for an aggregate consideration of US$1,000, which consideration is hereby declared fully paid and non-assessable prior to share issuance. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the corporation shall be at the office of the appointed registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and that such registered agent shall serve as the recipient of legal process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following initial officers be appointed: Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and Corporate Secretary, each to serve until the next annual meeting or until successors are duly elected. RESOLVED FINALLY, that the President and Secretary are authorized to open bank and payment accounts, execute banking forms, and take all lawful actions to complete the formation and licensing process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a corporate name reservation request through the Registrar's official filing window or correspondence desk, pay the prescribed reservation fee, and obtain the Name Reservation Certificate before endorsing the Articles of Incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected as confusingly similar, file an amended reservation with a distinguishing suffix or alternative name and provide comparative evidence that the proposed name is not likely to mislead.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Articles and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notarial Section, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Articles of Incorporation before a notary, designate the registered agent and registered office address in Majuro, and execute the written consent of the registered agent. This step creates the conclusive statutory text that will be submitted to the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
Copy of the incorporator's passport for notarial certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarial certification is queried, redeliver corrected signatures with supporting identity documentation within two business days and re-notarize before the filing deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Submission of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the original notarized Articles of Incorporation, registered agent consent, and name reservation certificate to the Registrar, either by physical lodgment at the Majuro registry counter or through the official registry submission channel, with the applicable filing fee invoice.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues an objection or information request, respond in writing within fifteen days with the required corrective information and pay any minor correction fee; if rejected, amend and resubmit the Articles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Registration Fee and Issuance of Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Filing and Payments Desk, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Effectuate payment of the statutory registration fee against the registry invoice and collect the Certificate of Incorporation upon clearance of the fee. The Certificate shall be contemporaneously signed by the Registrar and sealed to evidence corporate existence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment reconciliation is incomplete, supply the wire transfer or deposit slip and request re-issuance of the Certificate; corrected certificates are issued upon verification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting and Adoption of Initial Corporate Structure
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Directors and incorporators acting at an organizational meeting pursuant to the Business Corporations Act, no registry filing required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold an organizational meeting or execute unanimous written consent in lieu thereof to subscribe the initial shares, approve the first board resolution, adopt bylaws, designate the registered office, and validate the registered agent appointment. Record all actions in minutes and retain them at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Waiver of notice or organizational meeting consent
Minutes of organizational meeting or written consent
Subscription agreement and first board resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a procedural defect is identified in the minutes or consents, execute a written corrective resolution and have the officers confirm the effective dates; no registry filing cure is required unless the Articles are affected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Initial Officers and Banking and Payment Gateway Documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Directors acting through internal written consents; external financial institutions and payment processors as selected
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Board of Directors appoints the Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and Corporate Secretary; approves the corporate bank account and payment gateway integration for Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe; and authorizes officers to execute account forms, deposit funds, and produce a certified corporate excerpt for bank and payment-service onboarding.
required_dossiers: Written consent of directors appointing officers
Oath or acceptance of office from officers
Beneficial ownership and due diligence forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If banks or payment processors query the beneficial ownership structure, provide a certified copy of the resolution, the corporate excerpt, and a certificate of good standing to satisfy receipt-of-funds due diligence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Business Licensing and Environmental Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Licensing Office, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; Environmental Protection Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Certificate of Incorporation is issued, submit the business license application, the proposed manufacturing process for hard-enamel lapel pins, and the environmental screening report to the Business Licensing Office and EPA. Upon clearance, obtain the operating license and environmental registration confirmation before starting physical manufacturing.
required_dossiers: Manufacturing process description and site lease
EPA environmental registration and screening checklist
Civil defense and fire safety application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the business license or environmental clearance is queried, submit the requested technical clarifications and amended site plans within thirty days; if refused, appeal the determination to the Licenses Appeals Board within fourteen days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licensing Office, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Operating License – Manufacturing / Light Industrial (Hard Enamel Lapel Pins)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II – Environmental Check Registration (not a full EIA Report) for small-scale enamel badge manufacturing, absent electroplating facilities that exceed statutory thresholds
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Effluent pH 6–9, total suspended solids not exceeding 30 mg/L, biochemical oxygen demand not exceeding 30 mg/L; VOC and solvent emissions to meet RMI ambient air standards; enamel sludge and metal polishing residues must be contained and transported by an EPA-licensed waste contractor; no heavy-metal-bearing discharge to storm drains or septic systems.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from the Majuro Fire and Safety Authority; Building Load Stability Certificate for machinery installation from the Ministry of Public Works; Occupational Safety and Health clearance covering chemical storage, fume extraction, waste handling, and personal protective equipment compliance for polishing and enameling operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance (portal: https://www.mof.gov.mh)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Marshall Islands does not impose a general income tax on Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporations. A foreign-owned non-resident Business Corporation (BC) is not required to obtain a national income tax TIN. If the BC maintains a local payroll, it must register as an employer with the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration and obtain a Social Security registration number for withholding and contribution purposes. The BC must also obtain a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) from the Office of the Foreign Investment Board if carrying on any local business activity; this is a business licensing requirement, not a tax registration requirement. No VAT or GST identification number exists in the RMI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No local RMI check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regime exists. A Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation is a juridical person with full legal personality and is not eligible for pass-through treatment under RMI law. For U.S. federal tax purposes, if relevant, the Marshall Islands Business Corporation is treated as a per se corporation, meaning no Form 8832 check-the-box election is available. No hybrid mismatch election can be made under RMI statute.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT, GST, or sales and use tax; indirect fiscal impositions are limited to customs import duty and social security contributions
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. There is no general consumption tax registration threshold. Customs import duty is triggered at the time of entry of goods into RMI customs territory, irrespective of turnover, and is settled through the customs clearance process.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping mandate applies to domestic commercial invoices. RMI Customs uses ASYCUDA World for electronic cargo declarations and customs clearance; exporters and importers must file electronic declarations through the customs portal. Paper invoices remain acceptable for commercial purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands does not impose VAT or GST, so there is no 0% export VAT rate and no VAT input credit refund mechanism. Goods exported from the RMI are simply outside the scope of any indirect tax. Duty suspension or remission may be available under the Customs Act for qualifying re-export or transshipment operations, but this is not a VAT zero-rating regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (RMI Customs Export Manifest)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Commercial Invoice describing the hard enamel lapel pins and ISIC 3240 classification
Certificate of Origin (where preferential tariff treatment is claimed)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank-supporting proof of foreign proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Because no VAT/GST zero-rating exists, there is no separate export zero-rating clawback penalty. However, any fraudulent or false customs declaration made to obtain a duty exemption, remission, or tariff preference is subject to RMI Customs penalties, including seizure of goods, mandatory payment of all duties and taxes, monetary fines of up to USD 10,000, and imprisonment for natural persons. The Minister of Finance may also retrospectively revoke any customs concession and recover the full duty shortfall. Export records and supporting bank remittance evidence must be retained for at least five years.

stage_4.bank_name: Bank of Marshall Islands, Inc. (BMI), Majuro
stage_4.account_class: Operational USD Current Account; separate USD 'Capital Subscription' collection account can be opened internally without interest-bearing features
stage_4.onboarding_viability_tier: High — Locally incorporated, licensed under the Banking Act 1991, serves as the RMI de facto clearing bank and deepest local USD clearing access.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of Business Corporation (BCA Section 116) with payment of the annual government franchise/renewal fee; annual report confirms registered office, registered agent, directors, officers, and issued share capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (submitted through the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the month of the incorporation anniversary each year (anniversary-based, not a fixed fiscal calendar); registered agents usually require the signed report and fee before the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-filing surcharge accrues (commonly USD 100 per month or part thereof in registered-agent practice); sustained non-payment or two consecutive missed filings may trigger administrative dissolution/strike-off by the Registrar after notice; reinstatement requires payment of arrears, penalties, and a reinstatement fee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and KYC Recertification (beneficial ownership, directors, and shareholding confirmation submitted to the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent under the RMI Registered Agents Act 2014 and RMI AML/CTF obligations (no public registry filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, concurrent with the anniversary/annual report cycle; any share transfer or change of directors, officers, or ultimate beneficial owners must be reported to the registered agent promptly (commonly within 30 days per agent KYC policy)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate government fine; failure to maintain current UBO records is an AML/CTF compliance breach, may trigger registered-agent resignation and regulatory penalties, and may impair banking, Etsy Direct Pay, and Stripe account relationships

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for this non-resident, tax-exempt Business Corporation. The BCA imposes no revenue-based or asset-based audit threshold. A statutory audit is required only for licensed banking, insurance, or fiduciary trust activities or for publicly listed companies; otherwise audits arise solely as a lender or foreign-bank condition.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No locally promulgated RMI GAAP. BCA Section 97 requires books and records that fairly reflect transactions and financial position; financial statements are customarily prepared under IFRS or US GAAP according to user requirements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: RMI has no public UBO registry. The licensed registered agent must hold current beneficial ownership and control information under the RMI AML/CTF framework and the Registered Agents Act 2014. An annual KYC/beneficial-ownership recertification is obtained from directors and shareholders together with the annual report. Any share transfer must be recorded in the register of members, reflected in the registered agent's records, and notified to the agent before or at the time of transfer so the next annual report accurately states issued shares and directors.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 - 1,500 per annum (market range for licensed RMI registered agent and registered office, including annual report logistics and UBO/KYC maintenance)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 5,000 for a voluntary or lender-required audit of a simple asset-light enamel-pin trading company; not a statutory cost for the standard exempt non-resident MBC

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for Non-Resident Business Corporation (RMI Income Tax Act 1989 does not tax non-resident domestic corporations on non-RMI-source income; no general corporate income tax for this exempt class).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory nil effective rate. The non-resident BC qualifies for a full tax-exempt-zone model; no tax holidays or preferential deductions are required. Administrative annual registration/franchise fees are not income taxes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No RMI income tax return. Administrative filings: Annual Corporate Report with the RMI Office of the Registrar/Companies Registry via the registered agent; no tax return portal for non-resident BC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (administrative); no corporate income tax return is required or accepted for pure non-resident BCs.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No tax filing deadline. The Annual Report and renewal fee are due on or before the entity's registration anniversary date (subject to registered-agent filing calendar and any grace period under RMI Business Corporations Act).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RMI does not impose income tax on this non-resident BC. The company must annually confirm no RMI-source income, maintain registered agent and registered office in RMI, and update directors/shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident BC should submit a declaration of non-residence and avoid any local trading, employment, or permanent establishment in the Marshall Islands, otherwise tax exemption may be lost.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No tax late-filing surcharge exists for income tax. Late Annual Report/registration renewal incurs late fees and penalty interest under RMI Registrar regulations; continued non-compliance leads to dissolution/strike-off and loss of limited liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — no dividend withholding tax is imposed by the Marshall Islands on distributions to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network exists for the Marshall Islands; thus no treaty relief claim or RMI tax residency certificate is required in relation to RMI tax. If a foreign jurisdiction seeks proof of non-resident/tax-exempt status, the company may obtain a Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar; this is not a DTA TRC.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% statutory RMI withholding tax; 0% treaty rate (no DTA). Interest: 0% statutory RMI withholding tax; 0% treaty rate (no DTA). RMI does not impose gross-basis withholding on cross-border payments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold — RMI law does not impose mandatory Local File/Master File. Because the entity is tax-exempt non-resident, no RMI transfer-pricing documentation is required. For foreign disclosure, prudent threshold: US$1,000,000 in controlled transactions (USD local currency).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: RMI has adopted Economic Substance Regulations aligned with EU Code of Conduct standards. They apply to entities carrying on geographically mobile relevant activities (e.g., distribution, services) or entities claiming RMI tax residence. A pure non-resident BC that only owns and licenses enamel-pin IP/merchandise and has no RMI management-and-control generally falls outside ESR scope, but must not create de facto RMI tax residence through central management and control.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing or representing the corporation as non-resident while conducting RMI-source business, maintaining a local sales office, hiring RMI employees, or managing the company from RMI, for the purpose of evading domestic income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of tax-exempt status; reassessment of taxable profits by RMI tax authorities; penalties under RMI Income Tax Act 1989 including monetary fines (up to US$5,000 per false return) and, on conviction, imprisonment; cancellation of registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who signed false declarations or directed the evasion are personally liable for unpaid taxes, fines, and costs; RMI courts may pierce the corporate veil where the BC is an alter ego, exposing directors to civil restitution, travel bans, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Sham / Shell Company Used for Foreign Tax Avoidance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI non-resident BC as a paper owner of the enamel-pin brand, trademarks, or intermediate sales conduit without real economic substance or commercial rationale, solely to shift profits from high-tax markets such as the United States/EU.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI Registrar may strike off/dissolve an inactive shell; foreign tax authorities may apply CFC, GAAR, or substance-over-form rules to reallocate income and impose penalties (typically 25%–100% of the understated tax, with interest); criminal referral possible if fraud is documented.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors approving sham royalty/licensing arrangements may be named in foreign penalty proceedings; civil restitution, asset freezes, international travel bans, and extradition or director-ban orders may follow where they acted in bad faith.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to identify/update beneficial owners, receipt of Etsy/Stripe proceeds without customer KYC or sanctions screening, or movement of funds through opaque accounts connected to a non-resident BC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act and companion regulations, non-compliance attracts monetary penalties against the entity (up to US$500,000), daily default surcharges, suspension or revocation of corporate registration, and confiscation of assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who knowingly facilitate money-laundering or sanctions evasion are criminally liable: personal fines, imprisonment (up to 10 years), exclusion from directorship, travel bans, and civil claims for restitution; the corporate veil will not protect deliberate misconduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unauthorised Local Trading / Revocation of Exempt Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Physically producing, warehousing, or selling hard-enamel lapel pins from RMI or deriving any RMI-source gross income without converting to a domestic business corporation and filing required local reports.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The non-resident BC is treated as a resident domestic corporation for the period of local activity; RMI tax authorities may assess income tax on the full profits, plus penalties and interest; the Registrar may revoke the company's existence for transacting beyond its declared capacity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly cause unauthorised local trading are jointly and severally liable for the company's resulting tax liabilities and administrative penalties; piercing the veil is available when the corporation is used as a shield for unlawful local enterprise.
